revised_prompt: Create a modern tech brand header with a 3:1 aspect ratio. The composition should be oriented horizontally, optimized for Twitter, with an emphasis on a dark background (#0d0d0d) subtly patterned with a faint technical circuit/node network. The left third of the image should contain a glowing geometric logo symbol, ensuring to be positioned in the zone safe from profile picture overlap. The gradient, composed of vibrant shades of purple (#8b5cf6) and teal (#10b981), should flow from the left to right forming a wave-like pattern. Overlay 'Good Flippin Design' over this using modern typography, ensuring readability at both desktop and mobile sizes, offering a professional yet vibrant digital art aesthetic.
